decisions.decision: Run defect detection on the production-line devices
decisions.context: Cameras inspect products where network access is often unavailable. Defect detection must continue during network outages.
decisions.rationale: Local inference keeps inspection available without network access and avoids a network round trip for each image.
consequences: Devices need sufficient compute and storage.
The team must manage model versions across devices.

decisions.decision: Retrain the model centrally on newly labelled images
decisions.context: The model is retrained weekly using newly labelled images, while the team has limited infrastructure budget. Central training avoids requiring training hardware on every production device.
decisions.rationale: A shared pipeline fits a weekly cadence and avoids duplicating training work across the fleet.
consequences: New labelled images must reach the training environment.
Training infrastructure and dataset handling need ownership.

decisions.decision: Distribute versioned model packages to devices
decisions.context: Retrained models must reach cameras along production lines, many of which may be offline. Versioned packages let devices install a known model when connectivity is available.
decisions.rationale: Packages can be staged and installed when devices regain connectivity, without making inspection depend on a live connection.
consequences: The team must track deployed versions.
Updates may reach devices at different times.

decisions.decision: Keep inspection operational when model updates are unavailable
decisions.context: Devices often lack network access, so updates cannot be assumed to arrive on schedule. Each device needs a usable local model between releases.

alternatives.label: Retain the current local model until replacement

chosen.label: Retain the current local model until replacement

decisions.rationale: Keeping the installed model available preserves inspection during outages and allows updates to wait for connectivity.
consequences: Devices can temporarily run different model versions.
The team must define how long older versions remain acceptable.
